memo: Combination of our two new components on the public base saddamaditya/0-451-sota-forensics-lab-apex-synthesis v1 (public LB 0.451 as titled, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except marked insertions. Ours: (1) ours_lfrag (lfrag=1): learned fragment-explanation credits per bucket (cut level x hydrogen shift, linear and sqrt intensity), listwise softmax over 20 same-formula train isomers on 4,432 train molecules; held out enveda-180 MRR 0.723 -> 0.748, np-examples 0.567 -> 0.584; replaces frag_rescore everywhere. (2) cell B (bfrag=0.3): also applies the fragment score to molecules that already have a GLACIER/ICEBERG score, re-ranking the final top 25 within the formula by z(rank) + 0.3 z(frag). Submitted together because the two touch different molecules (blind/uncovered vs scored). Hypothesis: LB > 0.451 (bronze 0.446) and above each single-component run (e3a451lf-1, e3a451bf03-1).
message: e3a451lfbf-1: Apex Synthesis 0.451 base (GPU) + learned fragment credits + fragment re-rank on scored molecules. Hypothesis: LB > 0.451
